name: newegg-mcp
description: Newegg Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders

platform_mcp_newegg_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_API_KEY
platform_mcp_newegg_api_key.description: Newegg Marketplace API key assigned by the Newegg integration team (or your third-party developer key); sent verbatim as the Authorization header.

platform_mcp_newegg_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_newegg_secret_key.description: The seller's Secret Key (assigned to you, or to your third-party developer on the seller's authorization); sent as the SecretKey header.

platform_mcp_newegg_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_newegg_seller_id.description: Your Newegg seller ID (e.g. A006); sent as ?sellerid= on every call.

platform_mcp_newegg_country_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_COUNTRY_CODE
platform_mcp_newegg_country_code.description: ISO 3-letter ship-to country your prices target, e.g. USA; used in PriceList.Price[].CountryCode by update_listing/end_listing.

platform_mcp_newegg_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_newegg_currency.description: Currency matching country_code, e.g. USD for USA (wrong combinations are rejected).

platform_mcp_newegg_warehouse_location.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION
platform_mcp_newegg_warehouse_location.description: ISO 3-letter country of the warehouse whose stock set_inventory writes, e.g. USA.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Seller Status Check: {IsSuccess, SellerID, SellerName, Status (Active|Suspended|InActive|Terminated|Closed), Membership, WarehouseLocation...}.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Update Item Price (Type 1 = Seller Part #): sets the LIVE selling price for the configured country/currency. `listing_id` is your Seller Part #. Only the price is applied: stock is set_inventory; title/description are item content (datafeeds). Returns the item's PriceList in raw.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Update Item Price with Active 0 deactivates the item for the configured country (reversible with Active 1; while deactivated, price and inventory updates are disregarded).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Update Item Inventory (Type 1 = Seller Part #): sets AvailableQuantity in the configured warehouse country; `sku` is your Seller Part # (required). SBN (Shipped by Newegg) items cannot be updated.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Get Order Information (GetOrderInfoRequest): `status` is the numeric order status (0 Unshipped, 1 Partially Shipped, 2 Shipped, 3 Invoiced, 4 Voided, 5 Payment Pending); since = OrderDateFrom in Pacific time, e.g. '2026-09-01 00:00:00'; PageSize max 100. 1000 requests/hour. Items (ItemInfoList) and ship-to address are in raw.
